title: Good but some had flaws
text: Good but some had flaws. I was very please with my jars but pretty upset that 1/4 of the lids had nicks, small holes, and 2 lids were even broken. Returning them is too much of a hassle. I'm ordering another set and hope they are all good.

product_metadata.title: Churboro 24 Spice Jars with Labels- Spice Jars with Bamboo Lids - 4 Oz Glass Spice Containers with Shaker Lids, 547 Spice Labels of 3 Different Types Seasoning Jars for Spice Rack, Cabinet, or Drawer
features: GREAT VALUE PACK: Our spice jar set includes 24 empty glass spice jars, 24 shaker lids, 24 natural bamboo lids, 547 labels of 3 different types, 1 white chalk pen, and 1 silicone funnel for refilling. Everything you need for organizing your spices, provided in one package - an absolutely great value for your money.

HIGH QUALITY GLASS SPICE JARS: These spice jars feature shatterproof glass and are made from lead-free and BPA-free materials. The lids are made of natural bamboo for healthier ingredients. In addition, the airtight bamboo lids can keep spices fresh and dry.

CONVENIENT DESIGN: The shaker lids come in 2 different designs, ones with small holes for powder spices and ones with large holes for grains and herbs. These thick spice containers are transparent so that you know what’s inside and how much is left at a quick glance. Our modern square spice jars fit any drawer, cabinet, spice rack, cupboard, or organizer.

3 TYPES OF WATERPROOF SPICE LABELS: With 547 spice labels for common spices, this spice jar set includes 480 pre-printed labels in 3 different styles to help you identify different seasonings on similar glass jars and 67 reusable blank labels to fill in or erase with a chalk marker.

GOOD GIFTS FOR FAMILY AND FRIENDS: Our spice jars with labels are not only functional but also decorative. Imagine a kitchen that looks neat and beautiful with all kinds of beautifully packaged spices. Find organization and happiness while cooking meals. These spice bottles are easy to clean and dishwasher safe while we recommend handwashing the bamboo lids.
